title: Applying the Product Rule
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Differentiate f(x) = (3x^2 - 2)(x^3 + 4x) using the Product Rule.

steps.title: Identify Component Functions and Their Derivatives
steps.explanation: Label the two factors as u and v and differentiate each individually.

steps.title: Apply Product Rule Formula
steps.explanation: Assemble factors according to (uv)' = u'v + uv'.

steps.title: Expand and Combine Like Terms
steps.explanation: Expand products and group powers of x.
